title: One hired-agent transition door: legal moves, a status CAS, one board move
deviations_from_card: (1) AGENT_TRANSITIONS/canTransition live in app/_lib/db/agents.ts and lifecycle.ts re-exports them: the store enforces the table itself, and importing lifecycle.ts (which pulls db/pipeline for placeAgentOnBoard) into db/agents.ts would put the board module on every DB graph. (2) Acceptance 4 was followed over the coordinator's paraphrase: a rejected/failed hire's token still RESOLVES (only retired 404s, as the existing retired test pins); its lifecycle reports are answered 200 transition_refused and cannot revive the hire or file a card. (3) The series is feat (door + lifecycle.test) -> refactor (routes + route tests) -> chore(perf) -> docs rather than test-then-feat, so every commit is green. (4) perf-budget.json added to the write set (shared surface, under the lock): hire-from-need override 235/3112 -> 236/3114, this card's measured share.
notes: Slot B's approval clock: transitionHiredAgent writes ONE agent_activity lifecycle row per call; an applied move carries raw_json.transition = {from, to} and its ts is when the hire ENTERED `to`. Dispatch now writes the dispatched -> pending_approval row (event 'dispatched'), so slot B should read the newest lifecycle row with raw.transition.to == 'pending_approval' (and from != 'pending_approval') — never updated_at. Refused moves write status 'refused:<event>: <why>' with raw.refused = {from, to, current}. updateHiredAgentStatus and setHiredAgentRequest remain exported (test setup only; no production caller). Refresh also answers result:'transition_refused' when its CAS loses. tsc on the working tree is red only on sibling paths (app/devcase/apply/[token]/liveWork*.test.ts, PipelineBulkActionBar.tsx, untracked kpi-sim/). Full test:unit exit 1 on files not mine: python-runner-concurrency.test.ts BROKEN (process-tree kill, untouched area) and devcase-candidate-refusals.test.ts FLAKE (sibling devcase-session-api in flight); rate-limit-contract.test.ts fails 8 devcase-session cases from the sibling's uncommitted devcase routes. test:perf: measured base 159cdbae3 + this card's files alone -> only hire-from-need over (my +1 module/+10 KB, raised); committed HEAD additionally shows analyze, feedback-letters redraft, devcase approve etc. 1-5 KB over from sibling commits landed after the base (comms-dispatch-relay, analytics-computation, db-pipeline-store) — their share, not raised here; the wave-integration settle should take it.
